ai_summary: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited has disclosed receiving an unsolicited ESG rating of '67' from a SEBI-registered provider, Niche Ninety Nine Capability and Certifications. While offering an independent, publicly-sourced assessment of its environmental, social, and governance performance for investors, the company explicitly states it did not engage the rating agency. This highlights the rating's basis solely on public information, which may not capture the full scope of Dixon's ESG initiatives.
